svg.title: غرفة نوم صغيرة — مخطط غرفة نوم 3 × 4 متر
svg.desc: One 3 by 4 metre bedroom. A single bed labelled سرير at the northwest, wardrobe labelled خزانة at the northeast, and side table labelled طاولة at the southeast. A south door opens inward with a left hinge. One north window. Arabic lettering is contextually shaped and preserved as outlines.

g.text: 1 room · 12.0 m² · dimensions in metres to wall centre-lines
